player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: An pag-alis kinahanglan ha porma nga [macro micro] upod an mga numero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: An kada indeks kinahanglan aada ha butnga han 0 ngan 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: An micro_board, row o col in waray han sakob.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: An magdudula kinahanglan magdula ha sunod nga micro board.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} ginkalarak han micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} kinahanglan maglarak han {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: An manlalaro {player_id} in nagdaog han Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
